prompt:

Asset type: user-facing Five Elements model — Water element
Input images: Image 1 is the clay material, lighting, softness, camera, and finish reference only; do not include the oracle character

Style/medium: premium handmade matte 3D polymer-clay model; rounded collectible designer-toy proportions; subtle fingerprints and sculpting irregularities; same softness and polish as Image 1; clay, not liquid simulation
Composition/framing: one centered isolated object, front three-quarter view, compact clear silhouette, generous equal padding, no cropping
Lighting/mood: bright diffused studio daylight from upper left, soft neutral-lavender bounce; serene, clever, refreshing
Color palette: deep cornflower blue, clear sky blue, periwinkle, one small pale-lilac highlight; blue remains the dominant meaningful element color
Scene/backdrop: perfectly uniform flat chroma-key magenta (#FF00FF), edge to edge, for clean post-production cutout
Constraints: no character, no face, no eyes, no text, no Chinese characters, no symbols, no vessel, no ocean scene, no frame, no watermark, no cast shadow, no background texture or reflection; exactly one unified droplet-wave sculpture
Avoid: photoreal water, transparency or glass, splashes, flat icon, glossy plastic, storm imagery, extra droplets, extra objects, green background
